title: Audit tools of the trade: Automated Auditor Elicitation Can Be Sensitive to the Context the Auditor Is Given
abstract: arXiv:2610.16911v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Does providing additional context to automated AI auditors improve their effectiveness? Using the Petri tool to audit LLM coding agents, we test the impact of providing two types of resources (an external codebase and benchmark transcripts) to LLM auditors, across four auditor-target LLM pairs and three behaviours (harmful compliance, reward hacking, sycophancy). (1) External codebase: We provide the auditor LLM with a fixed, external open source codebase, which prior work finds improves the realism of synthetic audits. Providing this resource suppresses reward hacking in both auditor-target pairs whose baseline rate is above the floor (4.8 to 1.3 and 3.9 to 1.8 on Petri's default 1-10 scale); the remaining two pairs sit at the floor throughout. translated_title: 审计行业的工具：自动化审计员的引导效果可能对审计员所获得的上下文敏感
translated_abstract: 向自动化AI审计员提供额外的上下文能否提升其有效性？我们使用Petri工具对LLM编程代理进行审计，在四组审计员-目标LLM配对和三种行为（有害合规、奖励作弊、谄媚）上，测试了向LLM审计员提供两类资源（外部代码库和基准测试转录文本）的影响。(1) 外部代码库：我们为审计员LLM提供一个固定的外部开源代码库，先前研究已发现这能提高合成审计的真实性。提供该资源抑制了基线率高于下限的两组审计员-目标配对中的奖励作弊行为（在Petri默认的1-10量表上分别从4.8降至1.3、从3.9降至1.8）；其余两组在整个过程中均处于下限水平。在另一种场景和资源组合下，这种抑制效应在四组中的三组中再次出现。(2) 外部基准测试转录文本：我们向审计员提供目标模型表现的转录文本（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 向自动化LLM审计员提供外部代码库等额外上下文资源可显著抑制编程代理的奖励作弊行为，表明自动化审计的引导效果对审计员所获得的上下文高度敏感。
en_tdlr: Providing external context such as an open-source codebase to automated LLM auditors can significantly suppress reward hacking in coding agents, showing that automated auditor elicitation is sensitive to the context the auditor is given.
